title: Bill Of Materials
description: Bill Of Materials contract normalized from the DocuBricks Manufacturing library.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Document
metadata:
  name: docubricks-manufacturing-bill-of-materials
  title: Bill Of Materials
  description: Bill Of Materials contract normalized from the DocuBricks Manufacturing library.
  version: manufacturing_bill_of_materials_v1
  source:
    system: docubricks
    sourceId: manufacturing/bill_of_materials
    sourcePath: Schemas/manufacturing/bill_of_materials
    sourceVersion: manufacturing_bill_of_materials_v1
    sourceDigest: 3fa7502d4faa983933a0a228a41a4d99df6f551a85c986069a465adc7254f841
spec:
  documentType: bill_of_materials
  sections:
    - id: dates-and-terms
      title: Dates And Terms
      description: Dates And Terms fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - approval-date
        - effective-date
    - id: document-details
      title: Document Details
      description: Document Details fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - approved-by
        - bom-number
        - bom-revision
        - engineering-change-order
        - plant-or-site
    - id: financials
      title: Financials
      description: Financials fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - parent-part-description
    - id: line-items
      title: Line Items
      description: Line Items fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - component-items
    - id: property-or-asset
      title: Property Or Asset
      description: Property Or Asset fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - parent-part-number
    - id: risk-and-compliance
      title: Risk And Compliance
      description: Risk And Compliance fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - bom-status
  fields:
    - id: bom-number
      name: bom_number
      label: Bom Number
      description: BOM number or identifier.
      dataType: string
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/bom_number
    - id: bom-revision
      name: bom_revision
      label: Bom Revision
      description: BOM revision level.
      dataType: string
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/bom_revision
    - id: parent-part-number
      name: parent_part_number
      label: Parent Part Number
      description: Parent assembly or finished good part number.
      dataType: string
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/parent_part_number
    - id: parent-part-description
      name: parent_part_description
      label: Parent Part Description
      description: Parent part description.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/parent_part_description
    - id: effective-date
      name: effective_date
      label: Effective Date
      description: BOM effective date.
      dataType: date
      sourcePath: /fields/effective_date
    - id: plant-or-site
      name: plant_or_site
      label: Plant Or Site
      description: Plant, site, or manufacturing location.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/plant_or_site
    - id: engineering-change-order
      name: engineering_change_order
      label: Engineering Change Order
      description: Related engineering change order.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/engineering_change_order
    - id: component-items
      name: component_items
      label: Component Items
      description: Component list with part number, quantity, unit, revision, and scrap factor.
      dataType: array
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/component_items
    - id: approved-by
      name: approved_by
      label: Approved By
      description: Approver name or function.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/approved_by
    - id: approval-date
      name: approval_date
      label: Approval Date
      description: Approval date.
      dataType: date
      sourcePath: /fields/approval_date
    - id: bom-status
      name: bom_status
      label: Bom Status
      description: Released, draft, obsolete, pending, or other status.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/bom_status
  validationRules:
    - id: bom-number-present
      severity: error
      description: bom_number is required for Bill of Materials extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: bom_number
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: bom_number
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: bom_number IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(bom_number)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: bom-revision-present
      severity: error
      description: bom_revision is required for Bill of Materials extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: bom_revision
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: bom_revision
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: bom_revision IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(bom_revision)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: parent-part-number-present
      severity: error
      description: parent_part_number is required for Bill of Materials extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: parent_part_number
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: parent_part_number
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: parent_part_number IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(parent_part_number)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: component-items-present
      severity: error
      description: component_items is required for Bill of Materials extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: component_items
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: component_items
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: component_items IS NOT NULL AND JSON_ARRAY_LENGTH(component_items) > 0
      supported: true
  reviewPolicy:
    unsupportedRuleAction: human-review
    defaultConfidenceThreshold: 0.75
    fieldConfidence:
      bom_number:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: High-impact field for Bill of Materials workflow.
      bom_revision:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: High-impact field for Bill of Materials workflow.
      parent_part_number:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: High-impact field for Bill of Materials workflow.
      component_items:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: High-impact field for Bill of Materials workflow.
  modelRouting:
    primary: databricks-claude-sonnet
    fallbackChain:
      - databricks-meta-llama-3-70b-instruct
    maxTokens: 6144
    temperature: 0
    timeoutSeconds: 30
    maxRetries: 2
    tierOverrides: {}
    rationale: Bill of Materials documents combine manufacturing, quality, supplier, material, and operational
      control context.
  outputSchema:
    type: object
    properties:
      bom_number:
        type: string
        description: BOM number or identifier.
      bom_revision:
        type: string
        description: BOM revision level.
      parent_part_number:
        type: string
        description: Parent assembly or finished good part number.
      parent_part_description:
        type: string
        description: Parent part description.
      effective_date:
        type: date
        description: BOM effective date.
        format: date
      plant_or_site:
        type: string
        description: Plant, site, or manufacturing location.
      engineering_change_order:
        type: string
        description: Related engineering change order.
      component_items:
        type: array
        items:
          type: object
          properties:
            line_number:
              type: string
              description: BOM line number.
            part_number:
              type: string
              description: Component part number.
            description:
              type: string
              description: Component description.
            revision:
              type: string
              description: Component revision.
            quantity:
              type: number
              description: Component quantity.
            unit:
              type: string
              description: Unit of measure.
        description: Component list with part number, quantity, unit, revision, and scrap factor.
      approved_by:
        type: string
        description: Approver name or function.
      approval_date:
        type: date
        description: Approval date.
        format: date
      bom_status:
        type: string
        description: Released, draft, obsolete, pending, or other status.
    required:
      - bom_number
      - bom_revision
      - parent_part_number
      - component_items
    additionalProperties: false
  inertSourceMetadata:
    family: procurement_supply_chain
    completenessChecklist:
      - id: required_fields_present
        description: All required fields are present or explicitly null with low confidence when absent.
        fields:
          - bom_number
          - bom_revision
          - parent_part_number
          - component_items
      - id: section_coverage_reviewed
        description: Each declared section was reviewed for extractable evidence.
        sections:
          - dates_and_terms
          - document_details
          - financials
          - line_items
          - property_or_asset
          - risk_and_compliance
      - id: nested_lists_normalized
        description: Object array fields use their item_schema for consistent nested extraction.
        fields:
          - component_items
    sourceFiles:
      - fields.json
      - validation_rules.json
      - field_thresholds.json
      - model_routing.json
